source_name: FOAF.sk — Slovak company database and ownership-network aggregator
why_relevant: Free aggregator combining ORSR filings, full sets of accounting statements per company by year (PDF download) and public-procurement links; a useful redundancy layer when RÚZ or FinStat is unavailable, and good for ownership-link discovery around SK financial groups.

source_name: Dun & Bradstreet Slovakia (formerly Bisnode Slovensko)
why_relevant: Global commercial data vendor with a local SK entity (renamed from Bisnode Slovensko in 2022) selling normalised company financials, risk scores and DUNS-linked group hierarchies covering 190+ countries — the route to cross-border comparability for SK banks' parent groups.

source_name: Moody's Orbis (Bureau van Dijk) — global company database incl. SK banks
why_relevant: Aggregates 600M+ companies from 170+ sources, including standardised bank financials and ownership trees; the standard academic/corporate tool for building comparable SK-vs-CEE banking panels without re-parsing local statement templates.

source_name: OpenCorporates — Slovak commercial register mirror
why_relevant: Open, EN-language mirror of SK register entities with stable permalinks and an API; useful for entity resolution and linking SK banking entities into cross-jurisdiction datasets, though not filing-grade.

source_name: Internet Archive Wayback Machine — SK bank/regulator site snapshots
source_subtype: web archive with machine-readable index (CDX API)
why_relevant: Primary recovery mechanism for SK bank IR pages, press releases and PDF annual reports that were withdrawn or lost in site migrations (NBS's own restructure into nbs.sk/historia shows how common this is). The CDX API allows systematic enumeration of every captured URL under a bank's domain.

source_name: Webdepozit.sk / Webarchiv.sk — Slovak national web archive (Univerzitná knižnica v Bratislave)
why_relevant: National-deposit web harvesting of Slovak websites run by the University Library in Bratislava using OpenWayback — the sk-domain-specific complement to Internet Archive, with curated harvests that may cover SK financial-sector sites at depths IA missed.

source_name: Open Data Finančnej správy SR (ODFS)
why_relevant: Tax administration open-data portal (VAT payer lists, tax-debtor lists, registers) — an independent cross-check on the legal/operational status of SK banking and payment entities and their corporate counterparties.

source_name: Centrálny register zmlúv (CRZ) — central contracts register
source_subtype: statutory transparency register with open data/API
why_relevant: Mandatory publication of public-sector contracts; reveals which data/aggregator products the SK state itself buys (e.g. a published FinStat ULTIMATE annex) and exposes bank/payment-processor contracts with public bodies — an indirect window on pricing and vendor relationships.

source_name: companiesdata.cloud — guide to Slovak open company data, APIs and reuse rights
why_relevant: Third-party orientation page enumerating official SK company-data sources, their APIs and the legal reuse position — a fast snowball map, though a vendor-adjacent secondary source that must be re-verified against the registers themselves.

source_name: Finweek Bratislava (conference site + agenda/program)
why_relevant: Flagship Slovak fintech/banking/payments conference (2026 = 10th edition, 13-14 Oct 2026, Jurkovicova Teplaren). Bank and PSP executives state strategy, volume milestones and roadmap items on stage; the /program/ page names speakers and their affiliations, which is the cleanest actor map for the SK payments scene. Also hosts the FINAS Fintech Awards and previously the Zlata minca results announcement.

source_name: TechEvents Bratislava YouTube channel (Finweek panel recordings)
why_relevant: The spoken-word archive of Finweek: panel discussions are uploaded here. This is where a bank/PSP executive's unscripted numbers and roadmap statements actually exist verbatim, months before any annual report. Highest-value weak-signal channel in this cell.

source_name: Zlata minca - Slovak financial product awards
why_relevant: 20+ year-old award scheme scoring banks across ~13 banking categories plus 'Najinovativnejsia banka'. Nomination pages enumerate the actual product portfolio of every SK bank (accounts, cards, payment products) year by year - effectively a free product catalogue and competitive map; result pages name winners and are notarised. Award submissions surface product/positioning claims before formal reporting.

source_name: TREND TOP / Vyrocne ceny TREND - 'Banka roka' award and gala
why_relevant: TREND's 'Banka roka' is explicitly awarded on objective financial indicators (profitability, efficiency) computed by the TREND analytical team - i.e. a third-party ranking of SK bank financial performance announced at a gala each November, ahead of published annual reports. Also 'Poistovna roka', 'Investor roka'. TrendKonferencie.sk also runs sectoral conferences with bank-executive speakers.

source_name: Narodna banka Slovenska - Konferencie a podujatia
why_relevant: Central-bank-hosted conference series ('Slovensky financny trh a inovacie', capital-market anniversaries, etc.) where NBS officials and bank executives present supervisory expectations, innovation agenda (crypto, AI, instant payments, digital euro) and market data. Regulator-hosted = highest credibility spoken venue in this cell; slide decks are often posted.

source_name: FinNext conference (IBV NBS - Institut bankoveho vzdelavania NBS)
why_relevant: NBS training-institute conference 'Financny svet zajtrajska' with NBS representatives, heads of major financial firms and fintech innovators as speakers. Agenda + speaker roster is a reliable annual snapshot of who is authorised to speak publicly on strategy for each SK institution.

source_name: FINAS - Slovenska asociacia pre fintech (finas.sk)
why_relevant: Slovak fintech association: runs recurring FINAS Meetups (16th edition Mar 2026), the FINAS Fintech Awards at Finweek, an 'Expansion Hub' (licensing/banking-access support) and cross-border formats (Finweek Kuala Lumpur, FinTech Roadmap with the Czech association). Its member roster and meetup write-ups are the best pointer to non-bank SK payment actors that never appear in annual reports.

source_name: Slovenska asociacia pre fintech - Eventy | Novinky (slovakfintech.sk)
why_relevant: Second (older/parallel) Slovak fintech association web presence listing sector events; also co-founded the Open Banking platform providing a discussion forum between banks and third-party providers (PSD2/TPP actors). Event listing serves as an aggregator of SK fintech/payments gatherings.

source_name: Slovenska bankova asociacia (SBA) - Novinky
why_relevant: The only body representing SK banks collectively; its officials (e.g. Marcel Klimek) speak on panels such as ITAPA's 'Od platby k faktúre'. The news feed carries the association's positions, sector aggregates and event participation - often the first public framing of a sector-wide payments change.

source_name: ZBK - Zdruzenie pre bankove karty SR (Aktuality)
why_relevant: Slovak bank-card association - the natural venue/announcer for card and acceptance milestones (contactless share, terminal counts, transaction volumes). Directly on-topic for a payments-hardware/acceptance intelligence brief and complementary to the Visa/Mastercard award channels.

source_name: Mastercard Awards Slovensko (Mastercard Newsroom Europe)
why_relevant: Annual Mastercard awards for the Slovak payment sector explicitly rank issuers and acquirers - e.g. Prima banka for highest absolute number of card transactions, Tatra banka on the acceptance side, product/innovation awards to CSOB, UniCredit Bank, VUB. This is scheme-verified relative volume information that banks themselves rarely publish, released as a scheme press release.

source_name: Visa Awards Slovensko (via Forbes.sk event coverage)
why_relevant: Visa's separate Slovak awards edition rewards banks that push payment innovation; 2025 coverage reports Slovakia among the first European markets to complete an AI-agent-initiated transaction, with Slovenska sporitelna, Tatra banka, VUB and CSOB as winners. Exactly the kind of first-stated milestone this cell exists to catch.

source_name: ITAPA congress (Jarna / Jesenna ITAPA) - programme
why_relevant: The main SK digitalisation congress; its programme now carries payments-infrastructure panels (e.g. 'Od platby k fakture: ako stat digitalizuje cely biznis flow' with the Financial Administration president, SBA, SOFTIP, Slovakia.Digital) covering eKasa QR payments, instant-payment notifications at the till, cashless sale without a terminal, and eFaktura. Direct early signal on state-driven changes to POS/terminal demand.

source_name: Forbes Slovensko - Podujatia (Money Summit / Money Masterminds / Business Fest)
why_relevant: Forbes SK runs the money/finance event franchise where bank and neobank CEOs speak (e.g. Andrej Zatko, ex-CEO 365.bank; J&T Banka analyst Stanislav Panis). Post-event write-ups paraphrase on-stage claims; the events hub (eventy.forbes.sk) exposes speaker rosters in advance.

source_name: FinReport.sk - Podujatia / PR-clanky section
why_relevant: The most consistent Slovak trade outlet covering financial-sector conferences and award galas (Finweek, ITAPA, TREND TOP, Forbes Money Summit). Its PR-clanky feed effectively republishes organiser press releases, so it is the cheapest single crawl to detect that an event happened and who said what.

source_name: Tatra banka LinkedIn company page
why_relevant: Executive-communication surface: milestone posts (transaction/AI-payment firsts, syndicated 'club deal' financings, award wins, CEO recognitions such as Michal Liday's 'Most Respected CEO') typically land on LinkedIn before or instead of the formal press room. Same pattern applies to Slovenska sporitelna, VUB, CSOB, 365.bank, Prima banka.

source_name: Tatra banka - Management / Press / Analysts page (executive roster)
why_relevant: Named board members and press/analyst contacts - the ground truth for who the 'executive voice' is when matching a conference speaker or LinkedIn post to an institution. Equivalent pages exist at each SK bank and should be mirrored to build the actor map for this cell.

source_name: FinTech Roadmap (CZ/SK cross-border fintech conference, with FINAS)
why_relevant: Organised by the Czech Fintech and Wealthtech associations in cooperation with Slovak FINAS; SK payment actors present here and CZ/SK market comparisons are made on stage. Useful for catching SK players' expansion statements made outside Slovakia.

source_name: SIA NEWS - Slovak award/event coverage (secondary mirror)
why_relevant: Carries combined award write-ups (e.g. a smaller bank winning both 'Trend Banka roka' and 'Zlata minca'), which is exactly where challenger/niche SK banks get their strategy narrative into public text. Redundancy source for award outcomes not covered by the majors.
